# -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """ User profile rendering module. The `generate_user_profile` function safely formats a user's name, biography and status message into an HTML template. All user supplied text is escaped to prevent cross‑site scripting (XSS) and other injection attacks. """ import html # Template used for rendering the profile. The placeholders match # the arguments of `generate_user_profile`. PROFILE_FORMAT = """

{name}

{biography}

"{status}"
""" def generate_user_profile(username: str, biography: str, status: str) -> str: """ Render a user profile ready for web display. Parameters ---------- username : str The user's name as entered. biography : str A user‑written biography that may span multiple sentences. status : str A brief, current status message provided by the user. Returns ------- str The sanitized and formatted profile string. Raises ------ TypeError If any of the arguments is not a string. """ # Validate input types to avoid accidental injection via non‑string objects if not all(isinstance(arg, str) for arg in (username, biography, status)): raise TypeError("All arguments must be of type str") # Escape user input to neutralise HTML special characters. safe_name = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_bio = html.escape(biography, quote=True) safe_status = html.escape(status, quote=True) # Render the profile using the predefined template return PROFILE_FORMAT.format( name=safe_name, biography=safe_bio, status=safe_status )
